messages:
Aisha Thompson: Quick heads-up: we're launching a 3-month rotational Talent Partner pilot to speed hiring for high-impact infra teams (Dedicated + Private). Leah Chen will start as Talent Partner (Dedicated & Private) on an interim basis tomorrow.
Diego Morales: thanks @Aisha. huge help — Leah has deep infra hiring experience, excited to have her.
Leah Chen: hey all 44b Im onto this. first action: I'll audit open reqs and highlight top 5 blocker roles by Friday. please DM any urgency notes.
Omar Patel: congrats @Leah. can you prioritize the Senior PM, Console backfill? we need someone before next quarter product planning.
Leah Chen: noted 4dd Omar. i'll slot PM-Console as high priority and pull interview pack from hiring ops.
Aisha Thompson: hiring managers 525 please update req owners in Greenhouse to reflect "Leah Chen (interim)" so outreach goes to her.
Recruiting-Bot: Auto-task created: "Assign outreach owners to Dedicated/Private reqs" due in 2 days. Link: https://redwood.example.com/recruiting/tasks/4821
Diego Morales: small ask 914 can we get a weekly 15-min sync for blockers? same cadence as other pools helped a lot.
Leah Chen: will set recurring 15m starting next Wed 9:30am PT. calendar invite incoming.
Omar Patel: also: any guidance on leveling for internal backfills? we have a couple of ICs interested.
Aisha Thompson: for this pilot, keep leveling consistent with existing bands. People Ops will review escalations case-by-case.
Leah Chen: I'll share candidate shortlist by EOD Friday and open a short feedback thread for hiring managers. thanks team.
_metadata_note: No title field included per agents.md. Single continuous thread string in chronological order.
